shrink: Delta debugging keeps a candidate only if it fails the same way, instead of failing at all, so shrinking never swaps one bug for another. Cost: it replays a lot, here 191 runs and 14.3 s to go from 33 faults to 2.
verify: A sweep of fresh seeds sized for 95% confidence instead of one passing replay, because a single pass can be luck. Cost: with no known failure rate it assumes 1% and runs 299 seeds, and the result is evidence, not proof.
